rose-hulman.mechatronics_summary: No mechatronics degree or minor is in the current catalog. ME 230 Mechatronic Systems is a course required in some robotics-minor tracks.
rose-hulman.verification_note: Current catalog and department pages reviewed October 16, 2026; no admission advantage is inferred.
unresolved: No current course rotation was found for ME/CSSE 435, ECE 425 and the CSSE AI electives; ask the robotics program director (Dr. David Fisher) or the ECE advisor.

The CSSE site lists a Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence, but the catalog's program list does not include it; confirm its status and start date with the CSSE department.
Whether CPE students can do a multidisciplinary robotics project inside ECE 460-462 is not stated in the catalog; ask the ECE department.
The Rose Research Fellows stipend amount and R-SURF current-year details are not published on the pages reviewed.
rose-hulman.recommended_major_route: Apply intending Computer Engineering (CPE). Add the robotics minor's CPE track: take ECE 320 instead of ECE 380, plus ME/CSSE 435, ECE 425, CSSE 463 and 8 credits of Robo Electives. Use the CSSE-eligible area elective and free electives for CSSE 461, CSSE 415 or CSSE 416.

rpi.bs_robotics_name: B.S. in Robotics Engineering (joint ECSE + MANE)
me_robotics_courses: Interdisciplinary: mechanical design + electronics + computing + AI (specific course numbers not published)
rpi.ecs_robotics_alt: B.S. in Robotics Engineering (new joint ECSE + MANE major, first class Fall 2026)
rpi.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Different declaration or transfer restrictions do not establish which application is easier. Use the recommended degree and published entry requirements.
rpi.university_admit_differential: Not established from comparable current major rates
rpi.university_admit_differential_reason: DIRECT primary ROBT major: official program invites incoming Class of 2030 to choose ROBT, with Fall 2026 first-year Introduction to Robotics. Current students may add or switch subject to program compatibility.
rpi.internal_gate_differential_reason: "Undergraduate students typically declare a major by the end of their first year"; no GPA threshold published.
rpi.admission_strategy: DIRECT primary ROBT major: official program invites incoming Class of 2030 to choose ROBT, with Fall 2026 first-year Introduction to Robotics. Current students may add or switch subject to program compatibility.
rpi.early_admit_lift_reason: Early-round rates describe different self-selected applicant pools; they do not establish a causal admission boost. Binding ED also requires an affordability decision.
rpi.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 1 / EA Dec 1 / ED II Jan 6
rpi.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. NY 67.5% vs OOS 68.5%.
rpi.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
rpi.robotics_ecosystem_reason: CATS Lab (Computational Autonomous Transportation) + several ECSE/MANE labs; ~8-10 robotics labs.
rpi.mechatronics_summary: No formal mechatronics offering at RPI; the joint MANE+ECSE Robotics degree covers the same ground.
rpi.verification_note: Reviewed current official sources; no causal admission advantage is inferred from aggregate early-round or college rates.

wpi.ecs_robotics_alt: B.S. in Robotics Engineering (ABET-accredited primary major)
wpi.robotics_easier_than_cs_reason: Different declaration or transfer restrictions do not establish which application is easier. Use the recommended degree and published entry requirements.
wpi.university_admit_differential: Not established from comparable current major rates
wpi.university_admit_differential_reason: University admission followed by first-year major declaration, usually near the end of B Term. No separate competitive RBE declaration gate was found in the reviewed official guidance.
wpi.internal_gate_differential_reason: No GPA threshold or capacity gate published; change of major handled in Workday. RBE page invites: "Undecided? No problem."
wpi.admission_strategy: Indicate Robotics Engineering as the intended major, declare during first year and plan the Unified Robotics prerequisites before advanced AI electives.
wpi.early_admit_lift_reason: Early-round rates describe different self-selected applicant pools; they do not establish a causal admission boost. Binding ED also requires an affordability decision.
wpi.best_early_deadline: ED I Nov 1 / EA Nov 1 / ED II Jan 5
wpi.oos_gap_reason: Private — no residency preference. MA 65.6% vs OOS 65.5% (essentially identical).
wpi.nc_applicant_note: No advantage or disadvantage from NC residency.
wpi.robotics_ecosystem_reason: Dedicated Robotics Engineering DEPARTMENT with 15 labs + 12 research clusters + largest RBE-degree student body in US. Tier-1-like for undergrad research access despite smaller absolute size.
wpi.undergrad_research_program: MQP (Major Qualifying Project) — every senior does a research/industry project
wpi.coop_pipeline: Required IQP and major-design MQP projects; industrial sponsorship is possible, not mandatory co-op or assured employment.
wpi.mechatronics_summary: WPI's Robotics Engineering BS is inherently mechatronics — no separate mechatronics degree needed. RBE = ME + ECE + CS integrated.
wpi.verification_note: Reviewed current official sources; no causal admission advantage is inferred from aggregate early-round or college rates.
